title.en: Original study pilot · expert review pending
title.ru: Авторский учебный пилот · ожидает проверки специалистом

description.en: Find the central claim, select evidence, and infer only what a text supports.
description.ru: Определяйте главную мысль, выбирайте доказательства и делайте только обоснованные выводы.

description.en: Interpret words in context, rhetorical purpose, and relationships between texts.
description.ru: Определяйте смысл слов по контексту, цель автора и связи между текстами.

description.en: Choose logical transitions and synthesize notes for a stated purpose.
description.ru: Выбирайте логические связки и объединяйте сведения для заданной цели.

description.en: Check sentence boundaries, agreement, modifiers, and punctuation.
description.ru: Проверяйте границы предложений, согласование, определительные обороты и пунктуацию.

description.en: Represent and solve linear relationships, equations, inequalities, and systems.
description.ru: Моделируйте и решайте линейные зависимости, уравнения, неравенства и системы.

description.en: Use the structure of quadratic, exponential, rational, and radical expressions.
description.ru: Используйте структуру квадратных, показательных, рациональных выражений и выражений с корнями.

description.en: Reason about rates, percentages, distributions, probability, and study design.
description.ru: Анализируйте отношения, проценты, распределения, вероятность и план исследования.

description.en: Connect lengths, angles, areas, volumes, and right-triangle ratios.
description.ru: Связывайте длины, углы, площади, объёмы и отношения сторон прямоугольного треугольника.

description.en: Locate evidence, distinguish False from Not Given, and obey answer limits.
description.ru: Находите доказательства, различайте False и Not Given, соблюдайте ограничения ответа.

description.en: Follow corrections, identify details, and check answer spelling and limits.
description.ru: Замечайте исправления, выделяйте детали, проверяйте написание и ограничения ответа.

description.en: Describe visual data accurately and develop a relevant, supported argument.
description.ru: Точно описывайте данные и развивайте аргумент, соответствующий заданию.

description.en: Develop connected spoken answers and reflect on the original recording.
description.ru: Развивайте связные устные ответы и анализируйте исходную запись.

body.en: First state the author’s central claim in your own words. Separate an observation from an explanation. For an inference, ask what must be true, not what could be true. Evidence must support the whole answer: reject options that add a cause, a universal claim, or a comparison the text never makes. When numbers are given, compare the specified groups and units.
body.ru: Сначала сформулируйте главную мысль автора своими словами. Отличайте наблюдение от его объяснения. Для вывода ищите то, что обязательно следует из текста, а не просто возможно. Доказательство должно поддерживать весь ответ: исключайте варианты с выдуманной причиной, абсолютным утверждением или отсутствующим сравнением. При работе с числами сравнивайте именно указанные группы и единицы.

workedExample.en: Original example: A town placed benches on two streets. Pedestrian counts rose on one street and stayed level on the other. Supported conclusion: the changes differed between streets. Unsupported conclusion: benches always increase walking. Other factors and a comparison group would be needed to establish a cause.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: город установил скамейки на двух улицах. На одной пешеходов стало больше, на другой число не изменилось. Обоснованный вывод: изменения различались. Необоснованный вывод: скамейки всегда увеличивают пешеходный поток. Для причинного вывода нужны другие данные и группа сравнения.

title.en: Read the job of a word or sentence

body.en: Replace an unfamiliar word with a simple phrase before looking at options. Read the surrounding contrast or example. For purpose questions, describe what the sentence does: introduces a claim, gives an example, limits a conclusion, or challenges an explanation. For paired texts, record each author’s position separately before identifying agreement.
body.ru: До просмотра вариантов замените незнакомое слово простой фразой. Найдите соседнее противопоставление или пример. В вопросах о цели определите функцию предложения: тезис, пример, ограничение вывода или возражение. В парных текстах сначала отдельно запишите позицию каждого автора.

workedExample.en: Original example: “The archive is modest: just two shelves hold the entire collection.” Here modest means small, not embarrassed or virtuous. The phrase after the colon supplies the size evidence.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: «The archive is modest: just two shelves hold the entire collection». Modest означает небольшой, а не смущённый или добродетельный: после двоеточия указано доказательство размера.

body.en: Cover the transition and summarize both sentences. Decide whether the second adds, contrasts, gives an example, or states a result. Select a transition that expresses that exact relationship. For notes questions, underline the writing goal and include only the facts that achieve it; an accurate sentence can still fail the requested goal.
body.ru: Закройте связку и кратко перескажите оба предложения. Второе добавляет информацию, противопоставляет её, приводит пример или следствие? Выберите точную связь. В заданиях по заметкам подчеркните цель автора и используйте только нужные факты: правдивое предложение может не выполнять поставленную цель.

workedExample.en: Original example: “The seedlings received little sunlight. Nevertheless, they continued to grow.” Nevertheless signals an unexpected result. Therefore would incorrectly present growth as the expected consequence of little sunlight.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: «The seedlings received little sunlight. Nevertheless, they continued to grow». Nevertheless вводит неожиданный результат. Therefore ошибочно представило бы рост как ожидаемое следствие нехватки света.

body.en: Locate the main subject and finite verb before judging punctuation. Two complete clauses may be joined by a period, a semicolon, or a comma plus a coordinating conjunction. A comma alone is insufficient. Keep extra descriptions separate from the main subject when checking agreement. An introductory modifier must logically describe the subject that follows.
body.ru: До проверки пунктуации найдите подлежащее и личную форму сказуемого. Два самостоятельных предложения соединяют точкой, точкой с запятой или запятой с сочинительным союзом. Одной запятой недостаточно. При согласовании не путайте подлежащее с существительным внутри описательного оборота. Начальный оборот должен логически относиться к следующему подлежащему.

workedExample.en: Original example: “The box of old maps is upstairs.” The subject is box, so is agrees with the singular subject. Maps is inside a prepositional phrase and does not control the main verb.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: «The box of old maps is upstairs». Подлежащее box в единственном числе, поэтому требуется is. Maps находится внутри предложной группы и не определяет число сказуемого.

body.en: Define the unknown with units. Translate the relationship before calculating. Preserve equality by performing the same operation on both sides. In an inequality, reverse its direction when multiplying or dividing by a negative number. For a system, substitute or eliminate one variable. Finally place the result back into the original relationship.
body.ru: Определите неизвестное и его единицы. Сначала запишите зависимость, потом вычисляйте. Сохраняйте равенство одинаковыми действиями с обеими частями. При умножении или делении неравенства на отрицательное число изменяйте знак. В системе подставьте или исключите одну переменную. Проверьте ответ в исходном условии.

workedExample.en: Original example: A repair costs 18 dollars plus 7 dollars per hour. For a 53-dollar bill, 18 + 7h = 53, so h = 5 hours. Check: 18 + 35 = 53. The coefficient 7 is a rate, while 18 is the initial charge.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: ремонт стоит 18 долларов плюс 7 долларов в час. При счёте 53 доллара: 18 + 7h = 53, h = 5 часов. Проверка: 18 + 35 = 53. Число 7 — ставка, 18 — начальная плата.

body.en: Factor a polynomial to expose zeros; complete the square to expose a vertex; use an exponential form to show repeated percentage change. Check restrictions before canceling factors or squaring an equation. A canceled denominator still creates an excluded input. Squaring may introduce solutions that fail in the original equation.
body.ru: Разложение на множители показывает нули, полный квадрат — вершину, показательная форма — повторное процентное изменение. Проверяйте ограничения перед сокращением множителей и возведением в квадрат. Сокращённый знаменатель всё равно задаёт запрещённое значение. Возведение в квадрат может добавить посторонние корни.

workedExample.en: Original example: (x² − 16)/(x − 4) equals x + 4 only when x ≠ 4. The original expression is undefined at 4. A simplification changes the form but does not erase the original domain restriction.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: (x² − 16)/(x − 4) равно x + 4 только при x ≠ 4. Исходное выражение при 4 не определено. Упрощение меняет форму, но не отменяет ограничение области определения.

body.en: A percent needs a base; a probability needs a sample space; an average needs the number of values. Distinguish percentage points from percentage change. For a conditional probability, restrict the denominator to the given group. A random sample supports generalization to its population; random assignment supports causal comparisons between treatments.
body.ru: Проценту нужна база, вероятности — пространство исходов, среднему — число значений. Отличайте процентные пункты от процентного изменения. Для условной вероятности ограничьте знаменатель заданной группой. Случайная выборка позволяет обобщать на популяцию, случайное распределение по условиям — сравнивать причинные эффекты.

workedExample.en: Original example: A rate rises from 20% to 25%. This is 5 percentage points, but a 25% relative increase because (25 − 20)/20 = 0.25. The denominator is the old value, not the new value.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: доля выросла с 20% до 25%. Это 5 процентных пунктов и относительный рост 25%, поскольку (25 − 20)/20 = 0,25. Знаменатель — старое значение, а не новое.

body.en: Sketch the figure and label units. Use r, not the diameter, in πr². For similar figures, a length scale factor k gives an area factor k² and a volume factor k³. In a right triangle, identify the hypotenuse first, then name the opposite and adjacent sides relative to the requested angle. Convert degrees and radians deliberately.
body.ru: Сделайте эскиз и подпишите единицы. В πr² используйте радиус, не диаметр. При подобии коэффициент длин k даёт коэффициенты площадей k² и объёмов k³. В прямоугольном треугольнике сначала найдите гипотенузу, затем противоположный и прилежащий катеты относительно нужного угла. Явно переводите градусы и радианы.

workedExample.en: Original example: Similar rectangles have corresponding side lengths 3 and 9. The scale factor is 3. If the small area is 14 cm², the large area is 14 × 3² = 126 cm², not 42 cm².
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: соответствующие стороны подобных прямоугольников равны 3 и 9. Коэффициент равен 3. При малой площади 14 см² большая площадь равна 14 × 3² = 126 см², а не 42 см².

title.en: Prove the answer from the passage

body.en: Read the question and word limit first. Locate a paraphrase of the key idea, then read its whole sentence and neighbors. TRUE agrees with the text, FALSE contradicts it, and NOT GIVEN lacks enough information. Use passage words where required. Outside knowledge cannot fill missing evidence. These short original passages are skill drills, not full exam simulations.
body.ru: Сначала прочтите вопрос и лимит слов. Найдите перефразированную ключевую мысль, затем прочтите предложение и соседние. TRUE соответствует тексту, FALSE ему противоречит, NOT GIVEN означает нехватку данных. При требовании используйте слова текста. Внешние знания не заменяют доказательство. Эти короткие авторские тексты — тренировка навыка, а не полный экзамен.

workedExample.en: Original example: “The roof garden opened in May; entry is free on Tuesdays.” Claim: “Entry is free every day” is NOT GIVEN because prices for other days are absent. Claim: “The garden opened in June” is FALSE because May contradicts June.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: «The roof garden opened in May; entry is free on Tuesdays». «Entry is free every day» — NOT GIVEN: цены в другие дни не указаны. «The garden opened in June» — FALSE, поскольку текст указывает май.

body.en: Preview the gap and predict its grammar: a name, number, place, or action. Listen for corrections such as actually or instead; an early number may be a distractor. Keep spelling and the word limit in view. After submitting, replay the relevant time segment and compare it with the transcript. Pilot clips use clearly labeled synthetic speech and cannot represent all exam accents or interaction patterns.
body.ru: Просмотрите пропуск и определите нужный тип ответа: имя, число, место или действие. Замечайте исправления actually и instead: первое число может отвлекать. Проверяйте написание и лимит слов. После ответа прослушайте нужный фрагмент и сравните его с транскриптом. В пилоте явно обозначена синтетическая речь; она не представляет всё разнообразие экзаменационных акцентов и диалогов.

workedExample.en: Original example: “We originally planned room six, but it is being painted. Please meet in room eight.” The final room is eight. Write 8 if numbers are allowed; do not copy the first room mentioned.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: «We originally planned room six, but it is being painted. Please meet in room eight». Окончательный номер — восемь. Напишите 8, если допустимы числа; не копируйте первый услышанный номер.

body.en: For Academic Task 1, identify what is measured, the dates, and the units. Write an overview of the most important patterns, then select accurate comparisons with data. Avoid invented causes. For Task 2, answer every part of the question, state a clear position, and develop each reason with explanation or an example. Organize paragraphs by purpose and edit sentence boundaries. Feedback in this app is practice guidance, never an official band.
body.ru: В Academic Task 1 определите показатель, даты и единицы. Сформулируйте обзор главных тенденций, затем выберите точные сравнения с числами. Не придумывайте причины. В Task 2 ответьте на все части вопроса, выразите позицию и развивайте каждую причину объяснением или примером. У каждого абзаца должна быть цель; проверьте границы предложений. Обратная связь приложения — тренировочная, не официальный band.

workedExample.en: Original example: If bus trips rise from 40 to 60 thousand while car trips stay at 80 thousand, a defensible overview is: “Bus use increased, although cars remained more common.” It would be inaccurate to claim buses became the leading mode or that a fare cut caused the increase.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: если поездки на автобусах выросли с 40 до 60 тысяч, а на машинах остались на 80 тысяч, корректный обзор: «Bus use increased, although cars remained more common». Нельзя утверждать, что автобусы стали основным видом транспорта или рост вызван снижением тарифа.

title.en: Develop an answer you can say naturally

body.en: For a short question, answer directly and add a reason or example. For a long turn, use brief notes for a setting, event, detail, and reflection; avoid memorized scripts. In discussion, move from a specific example to a broader reason and acknowledge limits. Record the original response, correct transcription errors, and then review organization and wording. A transcript cannot establish pronunciation or a speaking band: listen to the audio yourself.
body.ru: На короткий вопрос ответьте прямо и добавьте причину или пример. Для длинного ответа набросайте место, событие, деталь и вывод; не заучивайте сценарий. В обсуждении переходите от примера к общей причине и отмечайте ограничения. Сохраните исходную запись, исправьте ошибки расшифровки, затем проверьте структуру и слова. По транскрипту нельзя оценить произношение или speaking band: слушайте запись.

workedExample.en: Original example: “I prefer studying in the morning because the house is quiet. Yesterday I finished a difficult reading exercise before breakfast.” The reason and concrete example develop the answer without adding an unrelated story. Replay to check that key words are understandable and pauses help the listener.
workedExample.ru: Авторский пример: «I prefer studying in the morning because the house is quiet. Yesterday I finished a difficult reading exercise before breakfast». Причина и конкретный пример развивают ответ без посторонней истории. При прослушивании проверьте понятность ключевых слов и полезность пауз.

exercises.prompt: Which statement best expresses the main idea?
options: Borrowing tools can make occasional repairs more affordable.
All households need to buy more tools.
Tool libraries repair every borrowed item.
acceptedAnswers: Borrowing tools can make occasional repairs more affordable.

explanation.en: The example shows how shared tools avoid the cost of buying equipment needed only occasionally. The other options add unsupported claims.
explanation.ru: Пример показывает, как общие инструменты позволяют не покупать оборудование для редких работ. Остальные варианты добавляют неподтверждённые утверждения.

hints.en: What problem does the example solve?
hints.ru: Какую проблему решает пример?

hints.en: Look at the contrast between owning and borrowing.
hints.ru: Найдите противопоставление покупки и заимствования.

typicalErrors.en: Mistaking a detail for the central point.
typicalErrors.ru: Подмена главной мысли деталью.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending
exercises.passage: A drill may sit unused for months after one household repair. At a neighborhood tool library, residents borrow a drill for a small fee and return it when the work is done. Sharing such equipment lets residents complete occasional projects without paying its full purchase price.
exercises.evidence: Sharing such equipment lets residents complete occasional projects without paying its full purchase price.

exercises.prompt: Which finding most directly supports the researchers’ explanation?
options: The shaded pond was deeper than the open pond.
Larvae in shaded water survived better than larvae in warmer, unshaded water when food was held constant.
Both ponds contained several plant species.
The ponds were visited by different birds.
acceptedAnswers: Larvae in shaded water survived better than larvae in warmer, unshaded water when food was held constant.

explanation.en: The controlled comparison links cooler shade to survival while holding food constant; unrelated pond differences do not directly support that explanation.
explanation.ru: В контролируемом сравнении прохладная тень связана с выживанием при одинаковом питании; другие различия прудов не поддерживают это объяснение напрямую.

hints.en: Identify the proposed cause.
hints.ru: Определите предложенную причину.

hints.en: Which comparison keeps a competing factor constant?
hints.ru: Какое сравнение сохраняет другой фактор неизменным?

typicalErrors.en: Selecting a related observation without testing the explanation.
typicalErrors.ru: Выбор связанного наблюдения без проверки объяснения.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending
exercises.passage: Researchers propose that a particular insect’s larvae survive better beneath floating leaves because the leaves keep the water cooler. They want evidence that separates the effect of shade from the effect of food availability.
exercises.evidence: the leaves keep the water cooler

exercises.prompt: What can reasonably be inferred about the notebooks?
options: They were written after the published report.
They record details omitted from the published report.
They prove every published measurement was wrong.
acceptedAnswers: They record details omitted from the published report.

explanation.en: The notebooks include unsuccessful trials, while the report includes only the final successful trial. Therefore some notebook details are absent from the report.
explanation.ru: Тетради содержат неудачные испытания, а отчёт — только последнее успешное. Значит, некоторые детали тетрадей отсутствуют в отчёте.

hints.en: Compare what each source includes.
hints.ru: Сравните содержание двух источников.

hints.en: Does the report include unsuccessful trials?
hints.ru: Включает ли отчёт неудачные испытания?

typicalErrors.en: Turning limited evidence into a sweeping judgment.
typicalErrors.ru: Необоснованное обобщение ограниченных данных.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending
exercises.passage: An engineer’s notebooks describe six unsuccessful trials of a new hinge and one successful trial. Her published report describes only the successful trial. A historian uses both sources to reconstruct the development process.
exercises.evidence: notebooks describe six unsuccessful trials ... published report describes only the successful trial

exercises.prompt: Which conclusion is best supported by the data?
options: Every visitor preferred the new labels.
Average viewing time was longer with the new labels in both rooms.
The new labels doubled the number of visitors.
Room A had more paintings than Room B.
acceptedAnswers: Average viewing time was longer with the new labels in both rooms.

explanation.en: Viewing time rose from 22 to 31 seconds in A and from 28 to 35 seconds in B. The table measures time, not preferences, visitor counts, or painting counts.
explanation.ru: Время просмотра выросло с 22 до 31 секунды в A и с 28 до 35 в B. Таблица измеряет время, а не предпочтения, посещаемость или число картин.

hints.en: Name the measured variable.
hints.ru: Назовите измеряемую величину.

hints.en: Compare old and new values within each room.
hints.ru: Сравните старое и новое значение в каждой комнате.

typicalErrors.en: Inferring an unmeasured variable from a table.
typicalErrors.ru: Вывод о величине, которой нет в таблице.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending
exercises.passage: A museum measured mean viewing time per painting. Room A: old labels 22 seconds, new labels 31 seconds. Room B: old labels 28 seconds, new labels 35 seconds. The museum did not survey preferences.
exercises.evidence: Room A: ... 22 seconds ... 31 seconds. Room B: ... 28 seconds ... 35 seconds.

exercises.prompt: Which statement best describes a limitation of the result?
options: The survey proves that longer opening hours caused every new visit.
The result cannot describe any evening visitors.
The survey excluded people who did not visit during the sampled evenings.
The result shows that daytime visitors oppose the change.
acceptedAnswers: The survey excluded people who did not visit during the sampled evenings.

explanation.en: Only evening visitors were sampled. Nonvisitors’ views and behavior remain unknown, so the result cannot establish everyone’s response.
explanation.ru: Опрашивали только вечерних посетителей. Мнения и поведение непосетителей неизвестны, поэтому результат нельзя распространять на реакцию всех жителей.

hints.en: Who was actually observed?
hints.ru: Кого наблюдали на самом деле?

hints.en: Which relevant people could never enter this sample?
hints.ru: Кто из важной группы не мог попасть в выборку?

typicalErrors.en: Generalizing beyond the sampled population.
typicalErrors.ru: Обобщение за пределы обследованной группы.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending
exercises.passage: After extending its evening hours, a gallery surveyed 120 people leaving on three evenings. Ninety said the later closing time made their visit possible. The director concludes that the schedule helps some evening visitors.
exercises.evidence: surveyed 120 people leaving on three evenings

exercises.prompt: Which observation would most strongly weaken the proposed explanation?
options: Objects dated decades before the workshop opened also contain the same pigment.
Several finished objects were sold locally.
acceptedAnswers: Objects dated decades before the workshop opened also contain the same pigment.

explanation.en: If the pigment appears in objects predating the workshop, it cannot reliably establish that an object was made there.
explanation.ru: Если пигмент встречается в предметах, созданных до открытия мастерской, он не позволяет надёжно отнести предмет к ней.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The function f(x) = (x − 3)² + 8 has a minimum value. What is that value?

explanation.en: A square is never negative, and it is zero at x = 3. Thus the minimum output is 8.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A culture begins with 80 cells and doubles every hour. According to this model, how many cells are present after 3 hours?

explanation.en: Three doublings give 80 × 2³ = 640. The initial amount corresponds to hour zero.
explanation.ru: Три удвоения дают 80 × 2³ = 640. Начальная численность соответствует нулевому часу.

hints.en: Count the number of doublings.
hints.ru: Посчитайте число удвоений.

hints.en: Multiply 80 by 2 three times.
hints.ru: Умножьте 80 на 2 три раза.

exercises.prompt: For x ≠ 5, which expression is equivalent to (x² − 25)/(x − 5)?

explanation.en: Factor the numerator as (x − 5)(x + 5), then cancel x − 5. The restriction x ≠ 5 remains.
explanation.ru: Числитель равен (x − 5)(x + 5). Сократим x − 5, сохранив ограничение x ≠ 5.

hints.en: Recognize a difference of squares.
hints.ru: Узнайте разность квадратов.

hints.en: Cancel a common factor, not separate terms.
hints.ru: Сокращайте общий множитель, не отдельные слагаемые.

typicalErrors.en: Canceling terms across addition or losing the domain restriction.

exercises.prompt: What is the solution of √(x + 6) = x, where the square root is nonnegative?

explanation.en: The original equation requires x ≥ 0. Squaring gives x² − x − 6 = 0, with roots 3 and −2. Only 3 satisfies the original equation: √9 = 3.
explanation.ru: Исходное уравнение требует x ≥ 0. После возведения в квадрат: x² − x − 6 = 0, корни 3 и −2. Только 3 удовлетворяет исходному: √9 = 3.

hints.en: What sign must x have?
hints.ru: Какой знак должен иметь x?

hints.en: After squaring and factoring, test every candidate in the original equation.
hints.ru: После возведения в квадрат и разложения проверьте кандидатов в исходном уравнении.

typicalErrors.en: Accepting an extraneous root introduced by squaring.
typicalErrors.ru: Принятие постороннего корня после возведения в квадрат.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: The equation x² − 6x + c = 0 has exactly one distinct real solution. What is c?

explanation.en: Exactly one distinct real root requires the discriminant to be zero: (−6)² − 4c = 0. Thus c = 9 and the expression is (x − 3)².
explanation.ru: Для одного различного действительного корня дискриминант равен нулю: (−6)² − 4c = 0. Значит, c = 9 и выражение равно (x − 3)².

hints.en: Use the condition for a repeated root.
hints.ru: Используйте условие кратного корня.

hints.en: Set b² − 4ac equal to zero.
hints.ru: Приравняйте b² − 4ac к нулю.

typicalErrors.en: Using a positive discriminant for exactly one distinct real solution.
typicalErrors.ru: Положительный дискриминант для одного различного действительного корня.

hints.ru: Рассчитайте скидку от начальной цены.

hints.en: Subtract the discount from 80.
hints.ru: Вычтите скидку из 80.

typicalErrors.ru: Ответ величиной скидки вместо конечной цены.

exercises.prompt: A data set contains 6, 8, 9, 11, and 16. What is its mean?

explanation.en: The sum is 50 and there are five values, so the mean is 50/5 = 10.
explanation.ru: Сумма равна 50, значений пять, поэтому среднее равно 50/5 = 10.

hints.en: Add all five values.
hints.ru: Сложите все пять значений.

hints.en: Divide the total by the count of values.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A pump moves 36 liters of water in 4 minutes at a constant rate. How many liters does it move in 7 minutes?

hints.en: Find the amount moved in one minute.
hints.ru: Найдите объём за одну минуту.

hints.en: Multiply the unit rate by 7 minutes.
hints.ru: Умножьте скорость на 7 минут.

typicalErrors.en: Adding the change in time directly to the volume.
typicalErrors.ru: Прибавление изменения времени к объёму.

exercises.prompt: A group contains 12 members who cycle and 18 who do not. Of the cyclists, 9 wear helmets. A cyclist is selected at random. What is the probability that this person wears a helmet? Enter a fraction or decimal.

explanation.en: The selection is restricted to the 12 cyclists, so the probability is 9/12 = 3/4 = 0.75.
explanation.ru: Выбор ограничен 12 велосипедистами, поэтому вероятность равна 9/12 = 3/4 = 0,75.

hints.ru: Кто может быть выбран по условию?

options: Students chose whether to join the study.
Students were randomly assigned to schedules.
The school has a large library.

explanation.en: Random assignment tends to balance competing factors between treatment groups, supporting a causal comparison for the study participants. It does not guarantee generalization to all students.
explanation.ru: Случайное распределение помогает уравновесить посторонние факторы между группами и поддерживает причинное сравнение для участников. Оно не гарантирует обобщение на всех учеников.

hints.en: Distinguish selecting participants from assigning treatments.
hints.ru: Отличайте отбор участников от назначения условий.

typicalErrors.ru: Смешение случайного распределения со случайной выборкой.

explanation.ru: Прибавление константы сохраняет порядок. Среднее по позиции значение меняется с 7 на 11, поэтому медиана возрастает на 4.

hints.en: How does adding a constant affect the ordering?
hints.ru: Как прибавление константы влияет на порядок?

hints.en: Compare the middle values.
hints.ru: Сравните центральные значения.

typicalErrors.en: Multiplying the shift by the number of data points.
typicalErrors.ru: Умножение сдвига на число значений.

explanation.en: The radius is half the diameter, or 5 cm. Area = πr² = 25π, so k = 25.
explanation.ru: Радиус — половина диаметра: 5 см. Площадь πr² = 25π, поэтому k = 25.

hints.en: Find the radius before using the area formula.
hints.ru: Найдите радиус до применения формулы.

hints.en: Square 5, not 10.
hints.ru: Возведите в квадрат 5, не 10.

typicalErrors.en: Using the diameter as the radius.
typicalErrors.ru: Диаметр вместо радиуса.

exercises.prompt: A right triangle has legs of length 9 and 12. What is the length of its hypotenuse?

explanation.en: By the Pythagorean theorem, c² = 9² + 12² = 225. The positive length is c = 15.
explanation.ru: По теореме Пифагора c² = 9² + 12² = 225. Положительная длина c = 15.

hints.en: Identify the two legs and the hypotenuse.
hints.ru: Определите катеты и гипотенузу.

hints.en: Take the square root after summing the squared legs.
hints.ru: После сложения квадратов извлеките корень.

typicalErrors.en: Adding the two leg lengths directly.
typicalErrors.ru: Прямое сложение длин катетов.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: A cylinder has radius 3 meters and height 5 meters. Its volume is kπ cubic meters. What is k?

explanation.en: Volume = πr²h = π × 3² × 5 = 45π, so k = 45.
explanation.ru: Объём πr²h = π × 3² × 5 = 45π, поэтому k = 45.

hints.ru: Умножьте площадь основания на высоту.

hints.en: Square the radius, then multiply by 5.
hints.ru: Возведите радиус в квадрат и умножьте на 5.

typicalErrors.en: Using circumference rather than base area.
typicalErrors.ru: Длина окружности вместо площади основания.

exercises.author: StylishSAT original AI-authored pilot, 2026-09-05; independent expert review pending

exercises.prompt: Two similar triangles have corresponding side lengths 4 and 10. The smaller triangle has area 24. What is the area of the larger triangle?

explanation.en: The length scale factor is 10/4 = 2.5. The area scale factor is 2.5² = 6.25, so the larger area is 24 × 6.25 = 150.
explanation.ru: Коэффициент длин равен 10/4 = 2,5. Коэффициент площадей 2,5² = 6,25, поэтому большая площадь 24 × 6,25 = 150.

hints.ru: Найдите коэффициент соответствующих длин.

hints.ru: Для площадей возведите коэффициент в квадрат.

hints.en: Find the missing adjacent side.
hints.ru: Найдите отсутствующий прилежащий катет.

hints.en: Cosine uses adjacent divided by hypotenuse.
hints.ru: Косинус — прилежащий катет, делённый на гипотенузу.

typicalErrors.en: Using sine when cosine is requested.
typicalErrors.ru: Синус вместо требуемого косинуса.

typicalErrors.ru: Подмена односторонних внутренних углов соответственными.

exercises.passage:
A. The fictional Fenmere museum owns a tower clock removed from a demolished station. For many years, visitors saw only its decorated face. During a recent conservation project, staff placed the mechanism behind a transparent panel so visitors could see how the gears interact. The clock now runs for ten minutes each hour to limit wear.

A maintenance notebook confirmed that repairs had been made in 1911, but it did not identify which components were replaced. The team therefore describes the gears as later additions without assigning them a precise date.

Staff also produced a digital model, allowing visitors to rotate the mechanism on a screen. The model improves access to hidden parts, but it cannot reproduce the sound of the running clock. exercises.sampleAnswer:
Allowing students to choose homework may increase their interest, but teachers also have a responsibility to ensure that essential skills are practised. In my view, students should have a limited choice within a set of tasks designed by the teacher.

Supporters of unrestricted choice argue that learners know which topics interest them. A student who enjoys environmental issues might willingly spend longer researching a local river than completing a general worksheet. Choice can also develop planning skills, because the learner has to decide what to study and how to present the result. However, interest alone does not reveal every learning need. Students may repeatedly avoid a difficult but necessary skill.

Teacher-selected homework can address that problem. A teacher who has reviewed classroom work can identify common weaknesses and assign a focused activity. This makes it easier to check whether the whole class understands an important idea before moving on. Nevertheless, a single identical task may be too easy for some learners and too demanding for others, which can reduce its value.

A balanced approach combines these advantages. For example, after a lesson on evidence, a teacher could offer three short texts on different subjects while requiring every student to support the same kind of argument. Learners would choose a topic, but the underlying skill would remain consistent. The teacher could then give additional targeted practice where needed. This approach preserves meaningful student choice while ensuring that homework contributes to the course rather than merely reflecting existing preferences. Such flexibility also helps students explain why a task matters.

exercises.sampleAnswer:
Publicly supported repair workshops can help residents extend the life of household items. Although such programmes require money and careful organization, I believe their advantages outweigh the disadvantages when they focus on useful skills and operate within a clear budget.

The main benefit is that repair can reduce avoidable waste. A broken handle or loose connection may cause someone to discard an otherwise usable object. In a supervised workshop, the owner can learn a practical method and apply it again later. The value therefore extends beyond the single repaired item. Workshops may also help residents who cannot easily afford replacements, particularly when tools are shared and attendance is inexpensive.

There are, however, real costs. A city must provide suitable space, equipment and competent supervision. Some repairs could also be unsafe if inexperienced participants work without guidance. These concerns are especially serious for electrical appliances. Public funding should not support activities simply because they are popular; authorities need a credible explanation of the likely benefits and the resources required.

The drawbacks can be reduced by defining the programme carefully. A city could begin with a small monthly workshop for low-risk repairs such as clothing and simple furniture. Trained staff could explain which items require a qualified specialist instead. Attendance, completed repairs and participants’ later use of the skills could then inform a decision about expansion.

Overall, the opportunity to reduce waste and teach reusable skills justifies modest public support. The strongest policy would combine accessible instruction with clear safety limits and regular evaluation, rather than treating every household repair as suitable for a community session.

exercises.sampleAnswer:
Museums increasingly provide online collections and interactive digital experiences. These services can reach audiences who cannot visit in person, but physical exhibitions offer qualities that a screen cannot fully reproduce. I believe museums should protect the quality of their physical collections while funding digital access as a complementary service.

The argument for making digital access the main priority rests on reach. A student living far from a major museum may be able to examine a high-resolution image at home without the cost of travel. Digital material can also be enlarged, translated or organized into different learning routes. A well-designed online exhibition may therefore serve people whose needs are not met by a conventional visit. These are substantial benefits, especially for institutions with a geographically dispersed audience.

Supporters of physical exhibitions emphasize the objects themselves. Seeing the scale, surface and arrangement of an artifact can change a visitor’s understanding in ways that a flat image may not capture. Physical collections also require conservation and secure storage whether or not their images are available online. If funding moves away from these responsibilities, the museum may weaken the very collection on which its digital service depends.

A sensible allocation should consider both purposes. For instance, a museum could conserve a fragile textile and display it for limited periods while providing detailed digital views throughout the year. The digital version would improve access without removing the need to preserve the original.

For these reasons, physical collections should remain a central funding responsibility. Digital services deserve sustained investment where they widen access or explain the collection more effectively, but they should be developed alongside conservation and carefully planned exhibitions, rather than replacing them.

Illustrative Part 2 response, not a memorization script: I learned how to repair a bicycle puncture from a neighbor last spring. Before that, I usually took my bike to a shop, even when the problem was small. One weekend the rear tyre went flat just before I planned to visit a friend. My neighbor showed me how to remove the tube, find the hole and attach a patch. I did the repair myself while he explained each step.

At first I found it difficult to put the tyre back on the wheel, so I had to slow down and try again. A few weeks later, I had another puncture and managed to fix it without help. That made the lesson useful in a very immediate way. More generally, it showed me that a practical skill becomes much easier to remember when I perform the steps rather than only watch someone else do them.

People crossed it on the way to the bus stop, but very few stayed there. The council added trees in large planters, moved the benches into shaded areas and left a clear path through the middle.

Illustrative Part 2 response: Last autumn, a friend and I decided how to use a free weekend during a short trip. I wanted to visit a science museum, while she preferred walking in the nearby hills. We initially treated it as a choice between two completely different days, so neither of us was very satisfied with the other suggestion.

We then checked the opening times and the weather forecast together. Rain was expected in the morning, but the afternoon looked clearer. The museum opened early and was close to our accommodation. We decided to spend the morning there and take a shorter walk later. This meant giving up the longest walking route, but it allowed us both to do something we enjoyed.

What I learned was that disagreement sometimes becomes easier when people examine practical details instead of repeating their preferences. We did not get everything we first wanted, but the final plan reflected both of our priorities and worked well on the day.
